subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to share the details of our upcoming trip. We have booked flights for Saturday morning and will be staying at the Hilton Hotel in downtown. I have also arranged for a rental car to explore the area. Please let me know if you have any preferences or need further information. Looking forward to our trip together! Best regards, [Your Name]
